bloxwich.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of the Walsall north
s1loc: Bloxwich runs a busy events calendar of its own. The Bookmark Bloxwich complex on Elmore Row stages shows at its theatre, the Walsall Arena and Forest Arts Centre on Hawbush Road handles concerts, tribute nights and comedy, and King George V Playing Fields on Stafford Road hosts Bloxwich Carnival, the Wakes funfair and the autumn fireworks. Over in Walsall, the Arboretum fills summer weekends with the Bostin Black Country Bash and a fireworks spectacular.

And the trade runs at every size. Major venues, festival operators and production companies across the Walsall north field large seasonal crews and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers around Bloxwich and Willenhall need just a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier here has to serve the big carnival and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.

Look past the headline events and the picture deepens. Funfair operators, marquee and staging contractors and PA hire firms work the playing-field shows, town-centre markets and church-hall productions keep their own grassroots calendars across Cannock and the wider borough, and amateur dramatic and operatic groups rehearse and perform through the year. From a carnival arena to a fireworks night or a hall pantomime, the same crews need branded, hard-wearing kit through the season.
